summary: ASUR filed a Form 6-K furnishing its routine monthly passenger traffic release for September 2026, with total traffic of 8.6 million passengers essentially flat year over year. Regional moves included Colombia +5.7%, Puerto Rico +3.1%, Brazil +2.6% and Ecuador +1.7%, against declines of 6.1% in Mexico and Costa Rica and 0.9% in Curacao. The release notes the first full month of Brazil, Costa Rica, Curacao and Ecuador operations after closing the CPC Aeroportos acquisition, but the filing itself is an operational disclosure with no new transaction terms, board recommendation or advisors.
